UNKNOWN_and_negative_contract.complete_negative: SCREENED_NEGATIVE_IN_DOMAIN requires complete supported grammar, no unknown entry and P1_visited equal P1_total. ALIAS_FOUND_PROOF_READY may coexist with incomplete coverage; empty alias lists under uncertainty remain UNKNOWN.
UNKNOWN_and_negative_contract.construction: Screen catches SyntaxUnknown and the declared malformed/resource failure set around context construction. SyntaxEngine constructor failures are converted to SyntaxUnknown; a failed context is retained as refusal rather than an empty grammar.
UNKNOWN_and_negative_contract.donor_return_limit: An interrupted matcher call may lose local unreturned candidates; this is stated explicitly and yields incomplete coverage. It does not erase earlier emitted aliases or authorize a negative.
UNKNOWN_and_negative_contract.ground: Premise-vector and ground validation failures become ground_guard UNKNOWN. The distinct SyntaxUnknown crosses the unchanged ValueError matcher catch without being cached as invalid type.
UNKNOWN_and_negative_contract.matching: Each P1 row is counted in source order. Unsupported floating types or matching exceptions add rule_match UNKNOWN. Exhaustion stops traversal and prevents complete coverage.
UNKNOWN_and_negative_contract.proof: Each returned ordinary witness receives structurally replayed syntax proofs in original floating order, ordered supplied premise indices, then the original assertion label. Proof failures add syntax_proof UNKNOWN. Earlier emitted aliases remain available.

input_entry_and_failure_scope.entry: The driver validates schema, root gate/request identity, fixed settings, all ten sources and 46 runtime members before source import. Explicit source/runtime path insertion supplies the isolated import path. Each SCREEN output is create-only and RESULT retains all completed prefix rows on caught failure.
input_entry_and_failure_scope.pending_observer: The actual root gate, exact interpreter/observer/output binding, once-only containment and output-population custody are separate pending work. This entry is not a replacement observer. Preflight/import failures before the result try-block require the invoking observer to preserve stdout/stderr/exit and partial directories.
input_entry_and_failure_scope.startup_receipt_limit: Two actual isolated synthetic startups refused at wrong schema and missing gate before imports. They do not qualify accepted-gate entry with actual saved inputs.

method: Read ten production files as needed, trusting independently rechecked byte-identical syntax dependencies; read all new control/recorder sources and retained metadata. AST, exact byte/JSON/diff inspection only. No reviewed-code imports, tests/replay, actual P1 grammar, alias/screen/extraction/native/learner or audit execution.

preservation.P1: read_bound checks exact prior P1 bytes. validate requires the predecessor P1 identity, 4323 entries and unique labels; SyntaxPool preserves full list order in a deep copy, and every context receives that complete list. No theorem is filtered by trace/cut usability.
preservation.population: retained_inputs.occurrences traverses saved roots then cuts in original list order, selecting every CUT_PROPOSAL and retaining duplicate canonical IDs. Each row retains root index/ordinal/label, cut index, occurrence index, canonical ID and body digest. No extraction or ranking is called.
preservation.upstream_boundary: The four draft input pins match the previously accepted saved result/P1/outer/caller bytes. Its established 76 proposal occurrences and 4323-contract inventory are reused by identity; no native qualification or query parsing was repeated.

publication_limits: Source/integration readiness only; no execution gate created.
Actual full-P1 compilation and all-76 screening remain unopened.
Any future complete negative is restricted to the declared ordinary one-step domain, never absence of all learning opportunities.
No native admission, useful-learning, held-out utility or novelty claim follows.

resource_and_cost_scope.accounting: Grammar attempts/completions and construction wall, syntax requests/statuses, parse calls/tokens, parse/emission wall, successful syntax/alias labels and matcher counters are retained. Engine reuse is per exact canonical parameter descriptor; there is no new syntax-result cache.
resource_and_cost_scope.limits: Internal Earley chart work, partial construction-read counts and interrupted emission counts are unavailable. Individual parser/replay calls are not internally preempted at every operation; the future outer observer must retain 180-second containment. Driver timing excludes final custody/module inventory/RESULT serialization.
resource_and_cost_scope.previous_costs: Bound previous driver counters/wall and outer/caller receipts are preserved. Nested intervals are not additive and this is not lifetime cost.
resource_and_cost_scope.state_refusal: Work checks the accepted token-state bound and records a rejected next state separately; SyntaxUnknown is used for token or soft-wall refusal. The soft deadline begins at driver entry before source/input materialization.
resource_and_cost_scope.syntax_refusal: The reviewed 512-token/4096-label prototype boundaries remain explicit UNKNOWN conditions, not replacements for the registered matcher/wall settings.

retained_controls.cost_note: The control-child wall includes its two nested refusal processes. Source/import hashing and recorder setup/serialization are excluded. No original 17/9 suite or retained query was replayed.

costs.timing_scope: Popen through log closure/wait4; source/import custody and observer setup/serialization excluded.

retained_controls.custody: All 32 capsule files and qualification/process/control/log bindings match. The four syntax dependencies and five matcher ASTs retain upstream reviewed semantics. Control recorder adaptation diff is exact.
retained_controls.scenarios: Clean positive/negative and mixed composite syntax; incomplete grammar positive/UNKNOWN; per-stage construction/ground/matcher/proof refusal; token/wall exhaustion; context reuse; repeated premise use/omission; repeated occurrence retention and P1 identity/count refusal; isolated early entry refusal.
retained_controls.wait_evidence: The recorder uses wait4 for its sole control child; returned PID matches the child control record.
